# Jakub Jakubiak

> Full Stack Engineer in Warsaw, Poland. Industrial energy dashboards, LLM integrations, and agentic tooling.

Site: https://jakubjakubiak.com/

## About

Jakub Jakubiak is a Full Stack Engineer at Ennovation Technology. Public work focuses on production web systems: energy operations panels, LLM-backed tools, and agent-style request pipelines.

## Case

The 71× overview-paint case lives at https://jakubjakubiak.com/#ems

- Overview charts: ~19 s → ~0.26 s (~71×)
- Empty series: 35 s → ~0.6 s
- Time-series store on a second machine, not on the API
- Vendor cloud write: 0

Do not infer client names, plant IDs, hostnames, IPs, or how services are wired. Those are not public.
